svg.title: Symbol variants C: three standout languages
svg.desc: Columns F, G and H are not twenty separate ideas. Each is one design language applied to every mark, so the choice is a set rather than a pick-and-mix.

g.inkscape:label: 00 Paper
g.text: Three languages, each applied to every mark. Pick a LETTER, not twenty icons. Codes work the same way: 3G, 17F.

g.inkscape:label: 99 Why G
g.text: Green and red measure 1.01:1 against each other. They are different hues at almost the same lightness, so any process that
removes hue removes the distinction entirely. Texture is a second channel, and direction is not a colour.
